messages:
alex: FYI: planned staggered deploy tonight across services: runtime 2.5.0 -> api 1.10.0 -> router 4.3. Change window 01:30-02:30 UTC. Need cross-service sequencing and rollback checklist.
tia: We have a console migration that depends on the api header flip (x-rdwd-v3). Console must remain behind FF until router mirrors header passthrough.
ben: Proposed sequence: 1) pin runtime and deploy 2.5.0 canary 5% for 10m, 2) deploy api 1.10.0 canary behind FF header_v3 10% for 10m, 3) router 4.3 full after api stable, 4) enable console migration FF.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime@2.5.0, api@1.10.0 (feature: api.header_v3), router@4.3. Start 01:30 UTC. :robot_face:
infra-bench: Preflight: GPU pool healthy, but two hosts show nvlink perf variance. Staging passed but watch tail-latency. Recommend 5min steady then ramp.
tia: Canary ramp change: 5% -> 20% -> 60% with checks at each step. Halt if p95 increases >180ms or error-rate >1.5% for 2 consecutive windows.
alex: Rollback semantics: if api canary fails, immediately disable `api.header_v3` FF, rollback api to 1.9.9, keep runtime pinned until we confirm compatibility. If runtime fails, unpin api/router and rollback runtime to 2.4.8.
ben: I'll prepare the rollback snippets and keep them in this thread. Quick commands for ops:
```
# rollback api
deploy-bot rollback api@1.10.0 -> api@1.9.9
# rollback runtime
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:2.4.8
# unpin calls
deploy-bot unpin api
deploy-bot unpin router
```
infra-bench: Add alerts: api.header.parse.warn > 30/min, router/retry-rate > 5% sustained, runtime/kv-evict spikes.
tia: Also enable 100% sampling for traces on /v1/* during canary windows and route traces to #eng-trace.
pagerduty-bot: Oncall set: ben (primary), tia (secondary). Pages will go to #oncall-ops and PD.
alex: Release notes draft: "runtime: KV eviction tunings and perf; api: header v3 (opt-in via FF); router: backpressure improvements; console: staged migration behind FF"
ben: Post-deploy hooks: migration-checker will validate console schema; e2e-smoke will run. If migration-checker fails, deploy-bot flags failure and auto-queue rollback.
alex: OK let's run at 01:30. Keep all signals/decisions here. Ping @ben for rollback call if anything trips.
infra-bench: Seeding dashboards now: api/header-latency, router/retry-rate, runtime/kv-evict, console/schema-errors.
tia: I'll be on-call for the window and own the rollback decision if api canary trips.
deploy-bot: preflight: images signed, smoke tests passed for runtime+api, router smoke pending.
alex: Thanks everyone. See you in the window.
